property_summary: For any admissible transfer call, the return value of c.transfer() must be true; the mutant incorrectly returns false even when no revert occurs.
For any admissible transfer call that completes without reverting, the return value must equal whether all subcalls succeeded; the mutant returns false regardless of subcall success.
The transfer function reverts when called by any address other than the hardcoded sender.
transfer reverts when called by any address other than the original hardcoded sender
The transfer function reverts when msg.sender is not the hardcoded from address.
transfer reverts when called by any sender except the fixed from address, regardless of array inputs.
The transfer function always reverts when called by any sender that is not the immutable sender required by the original contract.
